name: CoCr L-PBF sample, central 1.57 mm cube (set1sample2, NIST)

ground_truth.match_rule: object TP if it shares >= 1 voxel with a reference pore; IoU over all pore voxels

source.title: High-Resolution X-ray computed tomography (XCT) image data set of additively manufactured cobalt chrome samples produced with varying laser powder bed fusion processing parameters

attribution: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), mds2-2162; modified (cropped, windowed, downsampled, re-segmented) by Group 07 for X-Ray Hands.

processing.threshold_method: ISO50: halfway between air (median of darkest 0.3 %) and material (median) grey value
processing.denoise: 3x3x3 median filter before thresholding (as in the NIST reference pipeline); the displayed volume is the filtered one
processing.pore_rule: air enclosed by material (3D hole filling), 26-connected
processing.depth_note: interior (local) tomography + central crop: depth_mm is distance to the crop boundary, not to the part surface, so it is not charted
processing.cut_pores: pores touching the crop boundary are not enclosed and are excluded
